state.initial_message: My 2FA code is not working when I try to sign in.

messages.content:
I understand how frustrating it is to be locked out of your account. Let’s get your 2FA working again quickly.

1.  **Check Time Sync**: Ensure your device’s clock is set to automatic time. A few seconds’ drift can invalidate codes.
2.  **Regenerate Code**: Open your authenticator app and wait for a new code to appear. Do not use the previous one.
3.  **Verify App**: If you recently reinstalled the app or changed devices, the old code will not work. You must re-add your account.
4.  **Use Backup Codes**: If you have saved backup codes, enter one of those instead.
5.  **Reset 2FA**: If the above fails, go to the "Forgot 2FA?" link on the login page. This triggers a secure reset via your registered email or phone.

If you cannot access your backup methods, please reply with your account email so I can guide you through identity verification.
